FAQs

Here are some answers to frequently asked questions. If you can't find the answer you are looking for, please get in touch and we will answer right away!

What types of events do you perform at?

We specialize in performing at weddings, corporate events, private parties, and other special occasions. We also perform concerts

How much do you charge?

Every event is different with a range of factors to consider (travel, dates, booking length) so we provide a bespoke quote for each event. Prices start from just £500 and we have booking options to suit all budgets. Get in touch for a quote and we will get back to within a few hours, or sooner if we can!

How do I book?

Send a message via our contact form, or call direct. Tell us about your wedding or event. We will send you a quote. If you're happy, let us know and we will take it from there.

Do you have insurance?

Yes, all of our musicians have public liability insurance (PLI) via the musicians union. Certificates are available upon request.

Do you take requests?

Yes! We love requests, and we love adding new music to our repertoire. We include special requests in every booking!

Will you play outside?

Yes!, weather permitting. It's always a good idea to have a backup indoor plan

How can we make payment?

Bank transfer is the simplest. Payment details will be provided along with your contract.

Can I customize the playlist for my event?

Absolutely! We work closely with our clients to curate a playlist that suits their preferences and the atmosphere they want to create.

What happens if a member of the quartet is unable to perform on the scheduled date?

We have a pool of highly talented musicians, and in the rare event of an emergency or unforeseen circumstance, we will ensure a qualified replacement is available to maintain the quality of the performance.

Do you require a deposit to secure a booking?

Yes, we typically require a deposit to secure the date for your event. The remaining balance can be settled closer to the performance date.

How early should I book your services for my wedding or event?

It's advisable to book our services as early as possible to ensure our availability for your desired date. Popular dates tend to get booked quickly.
